title: Wear OS Graph Complication Feature Request/Discussion
symptom: The user wants a larger graph complication for Wear OS to see the full trend, as the existing complication is insufficient.
evidence_quote: I've been using the xDrip watch faces for a while, but feel like I'm missing out on some of the other wear os complications. The main reason I've been using the xDrip watchface is for the graph to see the full trend. Has anyone looked into making a larger graph complication to compliment the existing one?
